I am a Mathematics graduate from Universidad Rey Juan Carlos (Madrid), where I
completed a dual degree in Mathematics and Primary Education. I work at the point
where statistics meets clear communication: turning messy, large-scale data into
decisions that non-technical people can act on.

During a 676-hour Business Intelligence internship at PKF Attest, I collected,
cleaned and modelled data from SQL Server, MySQL and Navision into Power BI
dashboards across three client accounts, and presented the results directly to
business stakeholders. I work mainly in Power BI, R, Python and SQL.

This site is one of my two Bachelor's theses: An exploratory data analysis in R of
what drives downloads of educational math apps, with a full diagnostic and
robustness protocol. I care about reproducibility and about being honest regarding
what data can and cannot say.

I am available from September 2026 and open to relocating, with a particular
interest in data and BI roles in Switzerland. As an EU national, I do not need a
Swiss work permit.

**Languages:** Spanish (native), English (C1), French (basic).
